description: This file contains functions and types for handling Slack reply messages, including delivering replies, managing reply threads, and formatting message chunks for Slack. It is part of a Slack integration module within a larger project.

methods.name: readSlackReplyBlocks
methods.description: Returns Slack reply blocks for a given payload.

methods.name: deliverReplies
methods.description: Delivers a list of reply payloads to a target Slack channel, handling text, media, and block replies.

methods.name: resolveSlackThreadTs
methods.description: Computes the thread timestamp for Slack replies based on reply mode and message context.

methods.name: createSlackReplyDeliveryPlan
methods.description: Creates a delivery plan object for managing Slack reply threading and reply status.

methods.name: deliverSlackSlashReplies
methods.description: Handles delivering multiple reply payloads as Slack slash command responses, chunking messages as needed.
